items.title: Wendy Oxenhorn — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I found out Grandfather Oxenhorn was born in Romania.

ctx.x: You were just showing us photos of your parents, your grandparents. Can you tell us about your own genealogical bloodline?

Sure. We’re a good mix. I know we have a big gypsy side to us. I found out Grandfather Oxenhorn was born in Romania. Actually, we think it was even Transylvania. The other grandfather was born in Russia. They left... I think he was 16. I know he almost drowned. He had to escape in a river, and an old man saved his life, because he was drowning. He came to this country, and became a Charleston champion. There’s the dancer connect. He was an incredible, self-made man. He ended up with three jobs. He would take my…
I think you said the other grandfather was a doctor?
